_provenance.notes: Eastern Bering Sea (EBS) Walleye Pollock (Gadus chalcogrammus) is the world's largest single-species fishery by weight. The annual NPFMC Total Allowable Catch (TAC) for EBS pollock is set each December via Tier 3 stock assessment. A-season (Jan-Apr) processes surimi; B-season (Jun-Nov) processes roe & fillet. The 2021-2024 survey biomass has shown significant warming-related distributional shifts northward.
